movelist.name: Sandstorm
movelist.effect: The weather changes to a Sandstorm for 5 rounds. While it is Sandstorming, all non-Ground, Rock, or Steel Type Pokémon lose a Tick of Hit Points at the beginning of their turn.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Chip Away
movelist.effect: Ignore any Armor, Damage Reduction, or changes in the target’s Defense or Special Defense (such as from Combat Stages) when calculating damage.

movelist.name: Rock Slide
movelist.effect: Rock Slide Flinches all Legal Targets on 17+.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.effect: While suffering from Burn, Poison, Paralysis, Freezing, or while Asleep, the user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. If suffering from none of these conditions, the user loses any Combat Stages gained this way.

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Critical Hits; they are instead normal hits. Defensive.
